newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested on a live basis, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1225-1250 lbs 2 ld 64.00-65.00. Heifers; Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1250 lbs 2 ld 64.00-65.0.
On a carcass basis, steers and heifers not well tested.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs pt ld 102.50
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs pt ld 102.50
Reported sales for Wed: 200 Week to Date: 7,000
